Want to reverse-engineer viral video styles without copying the actual footage? Meet ReelMimic, an innovative agentic AI crew framework that analyzes reference videos and orchestrates multi-agent pipelines to recreate them in completely original styles. 🎬✨

Building automated video pipelines is notoriously difficult when you want to capture the pacing, shot structure, and stylistic appeal of a great reference video without infringing on original assets. ReelMimic solves this by letting you feed in a reference video and a brief, empowering developers to leverage Claude Code or Codex alongside specialized drawing engines to plan, generate, review, and assemble animated videos through a local agentic workflow. 🚀

Key Features:
• Comprehensive video breakdown analyzing shot counts, pacing, BPM, framing, transitions, and camera movements.
• Multi-agent production architecture where up to six agents handle parallel generation and independent peer review using proof-of-work screenshots.
• Support for seven distinct 2D drawing engines including vector motion graphics, watercolor, crayon, pixel art, paper cut-out, whiteboard, and anime cel.
• Interactive timeline feedback allowing users to scrub to any second, drop visual comments, and refine assets prior to final export.

For AI engineers, creative technologists, and full-stack developers, this serves as a production-ready reference architecture for multi-agent collaboration, task delegation, and strict verification loops. Whether you are automating custom marketing explainers or experimenting with self-correcting review cycles, it is time to upgrade your agentic workflow toolkit. 🛠️

Check out the repo and start building today:
https://github.com/edenfunf/reelmimic

Tired of your AI coding assistant writing PR descriptions and technical docs that sound like a walking buzzword generator? 🤖📉

Meet yomiyasu (https://github.com/nanaism/yomiyasu), a specialized agent skill designed to strip away fluff and transform LLM-generated Japanese text into natural, high-information-density technical prose.

LLMs are great at writing code, but their generated Japanese specifications, tech articles, and pull request notes are often plagued by unnatural phrasing, personification of inanimate objects, and list inflation. Instead of superficial keyword swapping, yomiyasu reorganizes sentence syntax and operational logic using strict syntactic principles (SVOCM) to ensure your technical writing sounds human, precise, and professional.

🔥 Key Features:

• Seven Core Syntactic Principles: Restores action agents, eliminates awkward phrasing, and converts vague metaphorical verbs into concrete technical operations.
• Multi-Domain Tuning: Adapt your stylistic needs across technical articles, business specifications, and documentation.
• Built-in Static Linter: Includes yomiyasu_lint.py to numerically score and flag AI-isms, excessive bolding, and list inflation with zero external dependencies.
• Seamless AI Integration: Installs instantly across modern coding environments like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex via npx commands.

Stop wasting valuable engineering hours manually cleaning up clunky AI prose. Automate the refinement loop and keep your documentation signal-to-noise ratio exceptionally high. 

👉 Check out the repo and drop it into your workflow today: https://github.com/nanaism/yomiyasu

🎮 Big news for .NET developers and game engineers: Capcom has officially open-sourced RE:Dox! 

Powering their next-generation REX game engine, RE:Dox is a high-performance, token-based structured data engine built to handle heavy serialization workloads without the baggage of heavyweight managed object trees.

🔥 The Problem It Solved:
Parsing massive JSON, JSON5, or MessagePack payloads in high-throughput environments usually leads to massive memory allocations and performance bottlenecks. RE:Dox solves this by parsing various data formats into a compact, fixed-size 64-bit token DOM—delivering up to 2.8x faster parallel deserialization and significantly lower memory overhead compared to standard serializers like System.Text.Json.

⚙️ Notable Features:
• 64-Bit Dual-Mode Token Core: Uses an extension bit to seamlessly handle both source-backed format data and RE:Dox-owned editable DOM nodes.
• Mutable Tape DOM: Supports node-like operations (inserts, removals, replacements) while keeping sequential performance cache-friendly.
• Asymmetric Read/Write Design: Direct one-pass writing via DataWriter paired with an addressable token DOM for look-ahead, out-of-order constructor binding, and automatic parallel deserialization.
• Lazy Decoding: Defers string and number decoding by storing offsets and lengths directly into the original source buffer.

Whether you are building high-throughput game asset and configuration loaders or optimizing backend microservices handling massive payloads, RE:Dox cuts through the boilerplate and simplifies multi-format data handling.

🎬 Tired of AI-generated videos that look janky, glitchy, or completely off-brand? 

We built the solution for developers and creative technologists. Introducing Motion Video Kit (echris6/motion-video-kit)—a Claude Code skill kit that bridges AI automation with high-end creative direction to produce professional, launch-style commercial videos.

The problem: Automated video generation usually suffers from a massive quality and predictability gap. You get frozen frames, misaligned brand colors, and awkward motion. 

Motion Video Kit solves this by combining rigorous human-like evaluation loops with programmatic motion. Here is what you get out of the box:

🔄 The Gauntlet Quality Loop: Separates the builder from the judge using dedicated critic prompts, item-by-item verification ledgers, and fresh reviews on actual renders.
✨ Deterministic Three.js & Code-Built Motion: Robust patterns for 3D product heroes, exploded layers, projected callouts, and precise motion grammar backed by a catalog of 16 reusable mechanisms.
🔊 Measurable Quality & Audio Standards: Automated checks for frozen frames, loudness targets, contrast ratios, and brand color compliance paired with professional SFX and mix guidelines.
💼 Business & Technical Tooling: Complete scripts for contact sheets, audio leveling, and frozen-time checks, alongside a full business playbook outlining pilot offers and pricing.

Whether you are building automated marketing video pipelines for SaaS products, e-commerce brands, or high-end 3D product hero commercials, this kit eliminates trial-and-error.

Transform messy enterprise documents, audio, and video directly into token-efficient Markdown for your RAG pipelines with Microsoft's MarkItDown. 🚀

If you are building RAG systems, knowledge bases, or LLM-powered text analysis pipelines, you already know the pain of preparing diverse, multi-format enterprise files. Wrestling with complex XML structures in DOCX, binary layouts in PDFs, and disparate parsing libraries wastes countless development hours. 

MarkItDown solves this challenge by converting standard Office documents, PDFs, audio, video, images, ZIP archives, and even YouTube URLs into clean, structured Markdown that preserves headings, tables, lists, and links. 

Key features include:
• Comprehensive multi-format support including audio/video transcripts and EXIF metadata
• Extensible plugin architecture for custom OCR support via LLM vision integration
• Seamless cloud scaling with optional Azure integrations for advanced layout analysis
• Flexible execution via a straightforward Python API and a Unix-friendly CLI supporting pipes

Use cases range from automated data ingestion pipelines that convert corporate file shares into searchable Markdown for vector databases, to audio and video meeting transcription processors that output structured text logs with YAML metadata headers.

🔗 Check it out on GitHub: https://github.com/microsoft/markitdown
